name: trade
description: Two-sided player trade window — the default interface for exchanging items AND credits safely. `trade <player>` opens a shared two-panel window; each side stakes items/credits, any change unlocks both sides (anti-scam), and the atomic swap only happens once BOTH lock in. Buttons drive the same `tradeoffer`/`traderetract`/`tradeready` commands you can also type.
